findings.title: Prior-epoch dependency knowledge is incomplete
findings.closure: Every dependency has a complete knowledge state; known-impossible dependencies invalidate dependants and only genuinely unknown evidence remains pending.

findings.title: Mixed carrier-claim precedence is incorrect
findings.closure: Reasoned claim and final-lineage reduction implements accepted, pruned, pending, excluded, all-unsupported, then invalid precedence.

findings.title: Checkpoint referenced-control states are collapsed
findings.closure: Checkpoint authorization consumes the shared resolver; missing and pending remain pending and known unusable references are invalid.

findings.title: Coordinate-scoped evaluation still performs unscoped work
findings.closure: Corpus-finalized coordinate indexes eliminate unrelated evaluation scans and all target lookup and claim work is metered.

findings.title: Finalization reservation is not mechanically consumed
findings.closure: Typed dimensions are atomically reserved and mechanically consumed; underflow, overrun, double consumption, and unaccounted work fail closed.

findings.title: The proposed NIP remains non-self-contained
findings.closure: The externally authored NIP is reconciled with every interoperability-critical companion rule and evidence is regenerated against its exact hash.

findings.title: Candidate identity and repository status documentation are stale
findings.closure: One candidate identity binds corrected commits, locks, authority, fixtures, reports, and holds while stale evidence is machine-superseded.
